text:
Maya R: Quick sync idea: run v2 in darklaunch but keep quota/billing semantics identical to v1 using a sliding-window quota increment to avoid spikes when traffic shifts.
Ethan C: Sliding-window makes sense. Instead of committing large retroactive token counts, increment small per-request windows so consoles show steady usage.
Zoe L: UX: Route page shows "Darklaunch v2 (sliding quota)" badge. Sidecar panel: live dark_pct, mapped_billed_tokens, observed_tokens, and a reconciliation link.
Maya R: Telemetry needs: compat.dark_pct, compat.sliding_window_tokens, compat.mapped_billed_tokens, rollout.autoreduce.reason. Also emit a sampling of request payloads for eval (opt-in).
Ethan C: Auto-reduce rule: if p95_dark_latency > SLO*1.25 OR error_rate_ratio > 1.5 for 5m -> halve percent. Emit rollout.autoreduce.count and reason tag.
Zoe L: Console alerting: warning when mapped_billed_tokens diverge >5% for 10m; critical >10% for 5m. Show sample tenant sessions in the reconcile view.
Maya R: Implementation sketch: decideRoute(); estimateTokens(); incrementQuotaSliding(tenant, v1_key, tokens); routeTo(v2); emit compat metrics. Sliding increments are idempotent via request-id dedupe.
Ethan C: Who owns mapping? eng-platform runtime-config with audit logs. Add nightly validator job to catch unmapped v2s.
flag-bot: FF guard applied: max change 25% per 10m; manual override required for larger steps.
Zoe L: Owners: Maya (RFC + rollout plan), Ethan (runtime mapping + sliding quota impl), Zoe (console mock + alerts).
Maya R: If no objections I'll open RFC and schedule 30m review.
Ethan C: SGTM.
Zoe L: SGTM.
